title: Introduce KV balance prober and adaptive spill demotion to reduce fragmentation-induced tail latency
author: Owen Park
body:
Motivation: High-occupancy tenants were experiencing intermittent tail latencies during heavy write bursts due to repeated aggressive spill-to-disk decisions followed by immediate re-admission of hot pages (thrash). This PR introduces a lightweight runtime probe (KV Balance Prober) that samples tenant page residency and a second-stage decision called Adaptive Spill Demotion which prefers marking pages as demoted/cold and attempting in-memory micro-compaction or intra-node remapping before immediate disk spill. The goals are: 1) reduce write-induced eviction churn, 2) lower long tail latency for mixed read/write workloads, and 3) provide observability hooks for eviction pressure and demotion effectiveness.

What this PR does (high level): implements a prober thread that collects per-tenant residency histograms with O(1) cost per sample, extends the eviction policy to support a demotion state (soft-evict) distinct from hard spill, adds a micro-compaction pass that opportunistically coalesces small fragments in a slot bin, and surfaces new metrics and traces to the Console for tuning. The scheduler receives a new kernel hint (prefer_low_blocking) that steers large compaction tasks to background lanes to prevent blocking short-lived generation kernels.

Details: - KV Balance Prober: periodic, adaptive sampling based on recent allocation churn; emits tenant->(hot_ratio,cold_ratio,frag_score) metrics and a compact snapshot used by the eviction controller for tenant-aware target occupancy. - Adaptive Spill Demotion: eviction policy now uses demotion windows: first soft-demote which sets page to demoted-state and tries micro-compaction or KV remap; only when demotion fails or pressure persists do we trigger spill-to-disk. Demoted pages are eligible for fast reclaim without cloning full page state. - Micro-compaction: small in-memory defrag step that coalesces fragments within a slot group; bounded to a few ms per invocation. - Scheduler kernel hint: tasks created by the demotion path set prefer_low_blocking=true so the runtime schedules them on low-priority background workers. - Observability: new per-tenant metrics (kv.demote_attempts, kv.demote_successes, kv.microcompact_time_ms_p95) and trace spans (kv.demote, kv.microcompact, kv.spill) wired into existing tracing/tags.

Migration/compatibility: Behavior changes are conservative; default policy is still to spill under high pressure but the demotion path is enabled behind a feature flag (kv.adaptive_spill.enabled=true). We include a migration plan and operator docs in the installer and Console docs. Benchmarks included in PR show ~40% reduction in 99.9p write tail for a mixed workload in our perf-lab when demotion is enabled with micro-compaction allowed.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc/notes linked - ENG-2314 - [x] Unit and integration tests for demotion path - [x] Perf microbench harness and results included - [x] Feature flag + operator config - [x] Console metric wiring and dashboard tiles - [x] Backwards-compatible defaults and rollout plan

Related: Linear ENG-2314, ENG-2789 (follow-up autoscaler hook), Jira SUP-922 for customer incident that motivated changes.

review_conversation: Ivy Chen: Please add a safety timeout for micro-compaction — a long compaction on high-fragmentation pages could hurt latency. Can we bound the compactor to N ms?
Owen Park: Added a 5ms budget per micro-compact invocation and an early-exit heuristic; updated tests to assert the budget is respected.
Marco Silva: The scheduler hint is fine but we should ensure background compactions do not starve GC tasks. Suggest adding a priority floor check.
Owen Park: Scheduler updated to treat prefer_low_blocking tasks as 'background' but with a minimum share so GC still gets CPU. Added integration test that simulates GC backlog.
Danielle Park: Could you add more observability when demotion fails and spills occur so ops can tune thresholds?
Owen Park: Added kv.demote_failure_reason tag with values (pressure, compaction_failed, remap_failed) and surfaced those in the Console tile.
Ivy Chen: Approving after small nitfixes to comments and docs.
Marco Silva: Approve. Verified perf numbers locally.
CI: One integration test flaked on first run (timeout); rerun passed.
release_notes: Introduced KV Balance Prober and Adaptive Spill Demotion to reduce eviction churn and write tail latency. Feature behind kv.adaptive_spill.enabled flag. New metrics: kv.demote_attempts, kv.demote_successes, kv.microcompact_time_ms_p95. See operator docs for rollout guidance.
